name: control-channel-failed-reads-healthy
for: The whole of #48 in one screen: a session whose remote-control channel is DEAD classifies — correctly — as an ordinary healthy idle session. Status is not the defect and must not be 'fixed'; the defect was that nothing else was carried, so 37 of 67 sessions came back from a fleet-wide recovery indistinguishable from working ones and the only way to find them was to grep pane text. This case pins both halves at once: status stays idle, and the control channel is reported failed. A regression that dropped the channel field would leave this case's `want` passing, which is exactly why the second assertion exists.
source: #48 (a fleet-wide recovery: 63 sessions lost at once, 67 rebuilt, 37 with no bridge)
redactedFrom: CONSTRUCTED, not captured.
